deliverables.firecracker_backend: FirecrackerBackend implements microvm-lifecycle LifecycleService (create/start/stop/snapshot/restore/status/metrics) using Firecracker; one process per VM configured over a per-VM UDS API; builder-injected trait objects for launcher/api-factory/readiness-probe/prereq/cleanup so orchestration is deterministic-testable; snapshot/restore return a typed unsupported error (todo 22)
deliverables.vm_process: VmProcess{vm_id,pid,socket_path,phases} tracks the child process, its API socket, and accumulated PhaseTimestamps; LaunchSpec{vm_id,argv,socket_path,env} describes the spawn
deliverables.boot_config: BootConfig{kernel_path,kernel_sha256,rootfs_path,rootfs_sha256,vcpu_count,mem_size_mib,boot_args,network} validated at construction; kernel/rootfs paths are relative and lexically validated via microvm-artifacts validate_relative_path (rejects absolute, .., symlinks, URIs); digests bind each path to expected content verified at boot
deliverables.phase_timestamps: PhaseTimestamps records spawn/socket_ready/configured/guest_ready/stopped; enforces ordering (predecessor required), uniqueness (once per phase), and monotonic non-decreasing timestamps; pure given the supplied clock
deliverables.uds_api_client: FirecrackerApi trait (put_machine_config/put_boot_source/put_drive/put_network_interface/start_instance/send_ctrl_alt_del/instance_info) with typed v1.16.1 request/response bodies; UdsApiClient is a minimal HTTP/1.1-over-Unix-socket transport (per-request connection, Content-Length and read-to-close bodies, fault_message extraction); non-2xx maps to TransportError
deliverables.guest_readiness: GuestReadinessProbe trait distinguishes guest readiness from process/socket readiness; TcpHealthProbe polls a guest TCP endpoint until success or timeout; ReadinessContext carries vm_id/guest_ip/timeout
deliverables.prerequisites: PrerequisiteCheck trait + HostPrerequisiteChecker verify KVM device, TUN device (when networked), Firecracker/jailer binary presence and (optionally) pinned provenance via microvm-isolation BinaryVerifier, and cgroup-v2 root availability — all synchronously and fail-fast before any child is created
deliverables.process_launcher: ProcessLauncher trait (spawn/wait_exit/kill/is_alive); TokioLauncher is the real tokio::process backend tracking children by PID with kill_on_drop; ScriptedLauncher scripts spawn/exit/kill for tests
deliverables.isolation_integration: Uses microvm-isolation CgroupManager (create_parent + apply_spec leaf with cpu/memory/pids limits), NetManager (setup_netns + TAP NetConfig + teardown), BinaryVerifier (pinned provenance in prereq), and CleanupManager (reverse-order idempotent teardown of process/socket/nft/tap/netns/cgroup/chroot); jailer argv built via validated JailerArgv for networked VMs, direct firecracker --api-sock argv otherwise
deliverables.audit_integration: Optional AuditLog records exactly one AuditEvent per mutating operation (create/start/stop) with Success/Denied/Error result; permission failures audit Denied, other failures Error
deliverables.testing_doubles: Public testing module: ScriptedLauncher (auto/fixed/fail pids, optional socket creation on spawn), RecordingApi + ScriptedApiFactory (records ordered ApiCall sequence, configurable FailPoint), ScriptedProbe (ready/not_ready), ScriptedPrereq (ok/fail); reusable by downstream lifecycle service (todo 15)

cargo_test_privileged_compile.note: firecracker_boot.rs compiles under the privileged feature; runtime is gated and reports blocked on hosts without KVM/binaries/artifacts

test_coverage.boot_config_validation: valid config binds paths to digests; absolute/.. /symlink/URI paths rejected with PathEscape; zero vcpu/memory rejected; boot_args length bounded; network None policy rejected; serde roundtrip preserves digests
test_coverage.phase_timestamp_recording: full boot+stop sequence records in order; ordering/uniqueness/monotonicity enforced; stopped requires only spawn; equal timestamps allowed; serde roundtrip; latest() tracks highest ordinal
test_coverage.error_mapping: spawn failure -> ProcessSpawnError + Failed; API config failure -> TransportError + Failed + cleanup; InstanceStart failure -> Failed (no guest_ready); guest-not-ready -> InternalError + Failed after InstanceStart; digest mismatch -> DigestMismatch + Failed with NO spawn and NO InstanceStart; missing boot config -> InvalidResourceSpec, stays Created, no spawn; prereq failure -> stays Created, no spawn; stop-from-Created -> InvalidTransition; snapshot/restore -> InternalError unsupported
test_coverage.prerequisite_checks: checker passes when all present; missing KVM fails first (before binary checks); missing binary -> BinaryProvenanceError; missing cgroup root -> CgroupUnavailable; TUN required only when networked; backend runs prereq before spawning any child (real HostPrerequisiteChecker with missing KVM -> no launcher invocation)
test_coverage.orchestration_replay: happy boot reaches Running with all four phases monotonic; API calls issued in order machine-config->boot-source->drive->network-interface->InstanceStart; machine config reflects boot config; kernel/rootfs host paths are the digest-verified tenant-root paths; networked VM uses validated jailer argv (--cgroup-version=2, parent-cgroup leaf, --netns); non-networked VM uses direct --api-sock argv with no network interface; start idempotent when already running; cross-tenant start denied + audited
test_coverage.audit_and_socket: audit log records create/start/stop success and denial; serialized VmStatus/VmMetrics never contain the API socket path or any 'socket' key (tenant non-exposure)
test_coverage.stop_and_cleanup: stop transitions Running->Stopped, records stopped phase, attempts graceful SendCtrlAltDel, invokes cleanup backend, audits success

guardrails.no_unauthenticated_socket_exposure: API socket lives under a host-only socket_root; VmStatus/VmMetrics carry only vm_id/state/created_at/resource_spec; test asserts the serialized tenant-facing responses contain no socket path or 'socket' key
guardrails.digest_validated_paths: kernel/rootfs opened relative to the tenant root via microvm-artifacts (RESOLVE_BENEATH/no-symlink) and SHA-256 verified before configuration; a mismatch fails closed before any child is created and never reaches InstanceStart
guardrails.prereq_before_spawn: KVM/TUN/binary/cgroup prerequisites are checked synchronously and fail-fast before the launcher is invoked; verified by asserting launcher.spawned() is empty on prerequisite failure
guardrails.guest_readiness_not_process_readiness: VmState::Running is reached only after the GuestReadinessProbe succeeds; socket_ready and guest_ready are distinct recorded phases
guardrails.typed_error_to_failed: process spawn and API errors drive the VM to VmState::Failed and trigger reverse-order cleanup; permission failures are denied (not Failed); host-capability prereq failures stay Created (retryable)
guardrails.firecracker_first: No QEMU or alternate runtime is introduced; Firecracker is the sole backend, pinned to v1.16.1 provenance via microvm-isolation

design_notes.determinism: All side-effecting boundaries (ProcessLauncher, ApiFactory/FirecrackerApi, GuestReadinessProbe, PrerequisiteCheck, CleanupBackend) are injected trait objects; the testing module provides scripted doubles so the entire boot/stop orchestration runs against tempdir artifacts and a simulated cgroup hierarchy with no capable host; PhaseTimestamps is pure given the supplied timestamp
design_notes.boot_config_via_trait: LifecycleService::create only carries a ResourceSpec, so the kernel/rootfs boot configuration is attached via the inherent set_boot_config (or a backend-wide default) before start; start resolves the effective config and digest-validates it
design_notes.launch_argv: Networked VMs launch via a validated microvm-isolation JailerArgv (--cgroup-version=2, pre-created leaf parent-cgroup, --netns, bounded resource limits, non-root uid/gid); VMs without network launch firecracker directly with an explicit --api-sock
design_notes.audit_model: Each mutating operation records exactly one AuditEvent; the trait wrapper maps the outcome to Success/Denied/Error so denial (PermissionDenied) is distinguished from operational failure
design_notes.privileged_lane: tests/firecracker_boot.rs is gated behind the privileged feature and follows the platform pass/blocked/failed model: it boots a real VM (create/configure/start/guest-ready/stop/clean) on a capable host with pinned binaries and staged artifacts, and reports a stable blocked token when KVM, binaries, cgroup-v2, or artifacts are absent
